question: Would a constrained piecewise-constant beta(t) with exactly 2 or exactly 3 breakpoints reproduce the day 110-150 acceleration of the first-wave active-case series, relative to constant beta, under one common retrospective fit?

series.y0_from: row t=0, columns S,I,R,D, no R or D offset

objective.name: daily_I_sum_of_squares
objective.rationale: Appendix F / Table A13 direct least squares on I(t), n=369. Not the Phase-1 weekly downsampled MSE.

solver.integration: one solve_ivp call per segment; state at the right endpoint is the next segment initial state

breakpoints.date_parameterization: softmax on excess length above 14 days; z components bounded to [-6, 6]

optimizer.other_starts: log-uniform beta, gamma, mu inside bounds; z uniform on [-2, 2]; independent segment multipliers log-normal sigma 0.35 around the draw

contextual_curve.label: published Phase-1 constant, 120-day fit, not the matched refit

metrics.g_early: mean of log(I[t+1]/I[t]) for t=0..109 (through day 110)
metrics.g_accel: mean of log(I[t+1]/I[t]) for t=110..149 (through day 150)
